notes: Forest-fire random-graph generator (Leskovec-Kleinberg-Faloutsos KDD'05, corrected variant). The model picks `ambs` ambassador vertices for each new node and then BFS-burns from each via geometric-distributed out/in neighbour counts (Geom(1-fw_prob) and Geom(1-fw_prob*bw_factor) respectively). At fw_prob = 0.20, bw_factor = 0.40, ambs = 2 the burn radius stays bounded by the geometric tail; throughput hovers near 1.6-2 Melem/s up to n = 10 000 because the per-actnode work is dominated by VecDeque push/pop and per-vertex Vec<u32> growth as the in/out neighbourhood lists accumulate (the only real bookkeeping cost beyond the SplitMix64 geometric draw). Directed and undirected mostly track each other since the Graph backing structure differs only in adjacency-edge insertion. No oracle baseline: python-igraph exposes Graph.Forest_Fire and rigraph exposes sample_forestfire, but RNG state is not portable, so conformance asserts structural invariants only (vcount, directed flag, is_simple via HashSet canonical-pair check, ecount band). Numbers from cargo bench --bench bench_forestfire -- --quick on Darwin/M-series release build.
